milestone.title: Plan hygiene sweep — W20 multi-value cleanup + validate-green guardrail reconciliation

intent.outcome: The repo's own plan passes `mp validate` cleanly under normal in-flight conditions (a milestone may legitimately depend on a not-yet-done milestone), every AC/step uses a single-value tests/verification entry per the step-testing convention, and a standing milestone exists to absorb further hygiene items surfaced during the review-backlog sweep.

problem.description: The 2026-07-01 baseline review exposed two hygiene gaps. (1) W20: 14 ACs/steps across M19/23/25/26/27/28/29/32/36/41/47 carry comma-list multiple values in `tests`/`verification`, violating the single-path-or-command convention (AGENTS.md step-testing; scripts/audit-step-tests.sh). (2) Validate-green guardrail tension: crates/mp/tests/mini_schema_e2e.rs::repo_plan_validates_via_mini_schema asserts `mp validate` exits green on the repo, but the dogfood plan legitimately has a forward dependency (M54 depends_on M77, still planned) so gate G8 ('dependency 77 is not done') correctly fires and the assertion fails. The guardrail cannot coexist with a normal in-flight dependency chain. This milestone also serves as the rolling accumulator for additional hygiene items found while clearing the 66-entry review backlog.

in_scope: Split the 14 W20 multi-value ACs/steps into single-value tests/verification entries (M19/23/25/26/27/28/29/32/36/41/47)

Reconcile the validate-green guardrail with legitimate forward dependencies: record the design decision and adjust repo_plan_validates_via_mini_schema (or the gate semantics) so a not-yet-done dependency under active execution does not fail the test
Accumulate further hygiene items surfaced during the review-backlog sweep as steps under this milestone
out_of_scope: M77 (raul TUI sidebar shell) and M54 execution — tracked by their own milestones
Per-AC deep re-review of historical milestones (that is the review process, not hygiene)
New features or behavior changes beyond hygiene/consistency

acceptance_criteria.description: Zero W20 warnings from `mp validate` on the repo plan
The validate-green guardrail test passes while the plan contains a legitimate forward dependency (M54 depends_on M77), via a recorded design decision and the corresponding test/gate adjustment
Every previously multi-value AC/step still resolves to a valid single test path or command after splitting

design_decisions.choice: Validate-green guardrail tolerates legitimate forward dependencies: repo_plan_validates_via_mini_schema asserts the repo plan has no schema/hygiene errors and no errors other than G8 fired on a milestone whose dependency is itself in-flight (planned/in-progress). A forward dependency under active execution is permitted and does not fail the guardrail. Gate G8 semantics stay strict.
design_decisions.rationale: The guardrail's intent is to catch schema/hygiene regressions, not to forbid normal in-flight dependency chains. The dogfood repo legitimately carries M54 depends_on M77 (planned) during 2.0 execution; G8 firing there is a true positive about ordering, not a defect. Keeping G8 strict preserves its ability to flag real dependency problems; narrowing the test assertion to non-G8 errors lets the repo validate under normal execution. Rejected alternative (relax G8 globally) because it would mask genuine dependency mistakes across all projects.
